auth.loginDescription: Enter your credentials to access your account
auth.registerDescription: Create an account to get started
auth.forgotPasswordDescription: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it
auth.resetSentDescription: If the email exists, you'll receive instructions to reset your password
auth.passwordChangedDescription: Your password has been updated. You can now log in.
auth.invalidResetLink: This reset link is invalid or has expired.
auth.checkYourEmail: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.
auth.awaitingApprovalNotice: An administrator of the organization must approve your registration before you can use the portal. We'll email you when that happens.
auth.pendingApprovalDescription: Your registration is waiting for an administrator of the organization to approve it. You'll get an email as soon as it is reviewed.
auth.emailNotVerifiedNotice: Your email address is not confirmed yet. Check your inbox for the confirmation link.
auth.emailVerifiedDescription: Your email address has been confirmed.
auth.verificationFailedDescription: This confirmation link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one below.
auth.ssoFailed: We couldn't complete the sign-in. Please try again.
auth.ssoEmailUnverified: Your provider account has no confirmed email address, so we can't use it to sign in.
auth.ssoRegistrationClosed: This organization is not accepting new registrations right now.
auth.ssoAccountDisabled: This account has been disabled. Contact the organization.
auth.ssoAccountLocked: This account is locked. Contact the organization.
